name: The Grey Sea
description: A cold grey sea under a low sky, with no coast in sight.

swell_a.name: Open Water
swell_a.description: Long, slow swells under a lid of cloud, and the Gull ploughing over them. Behind, the mountain of Tolmere sinks into its own smoke.

west.failure_message: The sea is no place to walk. You will need a ship.

east.failure_message: The sea is no place to walk. You will need a ship.

swell_b.name: The Dark Water
swell_b.description: The swells have gone black and steep and are running the wrong way. The sky overhead is yellow at its edges, and the air smells of struck iron.

west.failure_message: The sea is no place to walk. You will need a ship.
